overview: The City Council adopted a zoning map amendment for the Salem Street corridor alongside a negotiated plan to restart the city's zoning updates. The Council also received a presentation on the Affordable Housing Trust's five-year action plan and approved library union wage increases, a tree-planting donation, and historical preservation funding.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the November 18, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved committee reports concerning police department reporting on ICE activity and a real estate development presentation in the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Map Change (Paper 25160)
items.summary: Adopted the zoning map amendment changing specified Salem Street and Park Street parcels from MX2 to MX1, alongside a B-paper endorsing a joint press release with the mayor that outlines the framework for restarting the city's zoning project.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Action Plan and Guidelines (Paper 25181)
items.summary: Placed on file the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Action Plan and Guidelines for 2025–2030 following a detailed presentation on local housing demographics and a lengthy discussion on outreach and funding strategies.

items.title: Library Union Wage Adjustment (Paper 25182)
items.summary: Approved and ordained proposed multi-year wage adjustments for the library union, waiving the three readings.

items.title: Trees Medford Donation Acceptance (Paper 25183)
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $25,000 donation from Trees Medford to the Forestry Division for public tree planting.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriation for Shiloh Baptist Church (Paper 25184)
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $55,000 from the CPA Historic Preservation Reserve to support the ongoing ADA improvement project at the Shiloh Baptist Church.
